name: SF Dragons Soccer Camp
source: https://www.sfdragonssoccercamp.com/ (home, youth-academy-camp, and player-development-academy-camp pages), read 2026-10-07
neighborhood: Beach Chalet Athletic Fields & South Sunset Athletic Fields
description: Youth soccer camp for kindergarten through 8th grade, coached in a Brazilian style that builds technical skill and character. Two programs run side by side each week: a Youth Academy for K-3 players focused on ball mastery, coordination, and small-sided games, and an Advanced Development Academy for competitive players in grades 4-8 with targeted technique work and personalized development plans. Days include skill sessions, possession games and scrimmages, a goalie and finishing clinic, foot tennis, team building or art, and Friday pizza parties with a "Dragons World Cup Day." Led by head coach Willian Lelis, a former Brazilian professional with 20+ years of coaching experience. Weeks are held at Beach Chalet Athletic Fields, except Aug 3-7 at South Sunset Athletic Fields. Scholarships are available through the camp's Thrive Through Play initiative. Cancellations through March 30 get a full refund; after that, a credit toward another camp date.
dropoffPickupInfo: Check-in at 8:45am, camp runs 9:00am - 4:00pm, pick-up at 4:00pm. Extended care / after care: contact the camp at (415) 350-9779 or sfdragonssoccercamp@gmail.com.
packingList: Water bottle, lunch, snacks, and sunscreen. Comfortable athletic clothing. Shoes or cleats (recommended). A light jacket or sweatshirt -- mornings can be cold.

name: Lifetime Activities Little Tennis & Little Rallyers Camp
description: Beginner tennis camp for ages 4-7 at the Goldman Tennis Center in Golden Gate Park. No experience needed: little players learn tennis basics and build coordination through games on mini nets with low-bouncing balls. Two half-day options (Camp A 9:00-10:30am, Camp B 10:30am-12:00pm), about 5 kids per coach. The holiday flyer lists these weeks without saying which program runs which week -- confirm with the center. Registration is online (CourtReserve portal) or in person, not by phone. Withdraw 14+ days before camp for a refund minus a processing fee (3% or $12, whichever is greater); 7-13 days gets account credit only; under 7 days gets nothing. Need-based scholarships are available for SF-resident youth in group tennis programs (goldmantc@lifetimeactivities.com).
packingList: Athletic, closed-toe, non-marking shoes (no sandals, flip-flops, Crocs, or slip-ons). Snack and refillable water bottle. Hat and sunscreen. The summer guide asks families to bring an appropriately sized racquet (balls are provided). Please avoid peanut butter and nut products in snacks.

name: Lifetime Activities Junior Tennis Camps (Improvement & Matchplay)
description: Half-day tennis camps for ages 7-15 at the Goldman Tennis Center in Golden Gate Park. Youth Improvement is for beginner to intermediate players (no experience required): kids are evaluated on day one and grouped by age and ability for drills, games, and point play. Junior Matchplay is for intermediate to advanced players who can rally, serve, and play a basic match, with fast-paced drills and match play. Registration is online (CourtReserve portal) or in person, not by phone. Withdraw 14+ days before camp for a refund minus a processing fee (3% or $12, whichever is greater); 7-13 days gets account credit only; under 7 days gets nothing. Need-based scholarships are available for SF-resident youth in group tennis programs (goldmantc@lifetimeactivities.com).
packingList: Athletic, closed-toe, non-marking shoes (no sandals, flip-flops, Crocs, or slip-ons). A tennis racquet in an appropriate size (balls are provided). Snack and refillable water bottle for the mid-camp break. Hat and sunscreen. Please avoid peanut butter and nut products.

name: Lifetime Activities All-Day Tennis & Activities Camp
description: Full-day camp for ages 8-15, all levels welcome, at the Goldman Tennis Center in Golden Gate Park: tennis instruction 9am-noon, a supervised lunch, then 1-4pm rotations of chess, table tennis, pickleball, and more tennis. Wednesday is Character Day -- campers can dress as a favorite character. About 8 kids per coach at the holiday camps. The holiday flyer lists these weeks without saying which program runs which week -- confirm with the center. Registration is online (CourtReserve portal) or in person, not by phone. Withdraw 14+ days before camp for a refund minus a processing fee (3% or $12, whichever is greater); 7-13 days gets account credit only; under 7 days gets nothing. Need-based scholarships are available for SF-resident youth in group tennis programs (goldmantc@lifetimeactivities.com).
packingList: Lunch (campers bring their own) plus snacks and a refillable water bottle. Athletic, closed-toe, non-marking shoes (no sandals, flip-flops, Crocs, or slip-ons). Tennis racquet (balls provided) and a pickleball paddle -- loaner paddles are available in limited numbers. Hat and sunscreen. Please avoid peanut butter and nut products.
